mapper.select:
select m.PROJECT_ID , p.EXT_ORG_BU_NAME, p.EXT_ORG_OU_NAME, r.RECORD_ID , p.SOU_NAME, r.MARGIN_ID, p.EXT_PROJECT_NO, m.VENDOR_CODE , m.VENDOR_NAME mVendorName, m.HANDER_MODE, m.CAUSE_DESC, EXT_APPLICANT_DEPART, p.CREATED_FULL_NAME, m.PAY_AMOUNT, p.EXT_EARNEST_AMOUNT receivableAmount, p.EXT_EARNEST_AMOUNT paymentAmount, m.PAY_BANK, m.BANK_LINE, m.PAY_ACCOUNT, m.MARGIN_STATUS, m.TRANS_TIME, m.NO_PAY_CAUSE, m.PAY_NAME, r.VENDOR_NAME refundVendor, r.REFUND_BANK , r.REFUND_BANK_NUM , r.REFUND_ACCOUNT , m.REFUND_STATUS , m.REFUND_PAYMENT_DATE , cr.CREATION_DATE, cr.DESCRIPTION chargeDescription, r.DESCRIPTION refundDescription, r.AMOUNT refundAmount, plan.PUBLISH_TIME , plan.BUS_END_TIME, cr.VENDOR_NAME chargeVendor, cr.AMOUNT chargeAmount from scc_npm_sou_margin m left join scc_sou_project p on p.PROJECT_ID=m.PROJECT_ID left join scc_npm_sou_plan plan on p.PROJECT_ID = plan.PROJECT_ID and plan.PLAN_TYPE = 'PLAN' left JOIN (SELECT r.* from scc_npm_sou_margin_record r JOIN (SELECT MAX(rr.RECORD_ID) RECORD_ID FROM scc_npm_sou_margin_record rr WHERE rr.type = 'REFUND' GROUP BY rr.MARGIN_ID) tr ON tr.RECORD_ID = r.RECORD_ID) r on m.MARGIN_ID = r.MARGIN_ID
LEFT JOIN scc_npm_sou_margin_record cr ON cr.`TYPE`='CHARGE' AND cr.MARGIN_ID = m.MARGIN_ID WHERE m.MARGIN_STATUS='PAY' AND m.YEAR_FLAG='N'
/* and p.SOU_NO='BID2024062800462'*/
AND p.SOU_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{souName}),'%')
AND p.EXT_PROJECT_NO LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{extProjectNo}),'%')
AND p.CREATED_FULL_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{createdFullName}),'%')
AND m.PAY_AMOUNT = ${payAmount}
AND p.EXT_ORG_BU_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{extOrgBuName}),'%')
AND p.EXT_ORG_OU_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{extOrgOuName}),'%')
AND m.VENDOR_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{mVendorName}),'%')
AND r.VENDOR_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{refundVendor}),'%')
AND EXT_APPLICANT_DEPART LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{extApplicantDepart}),'%')
and convert(TRANS_TIME,char) like concat(concat('%',#{transTime}),'%')
AND m.PAY_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{payName}),'%')
and convert(plan.BUS_END_TIME,char) like concat(concat('%',#{busEndTime}),'%')
and convert(m.REFUND_PAYMENT_DATE,char) like concat(concat('%',#{refundPaymentDate}),'%')
AND r.AMOUNT = #{refundAmount}
AND cr.VENDOR_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{chargeVendor}),'%')
AND cr.AMOUNT = #{chargeAmount}
and convert(cr.CREATION_DATE,char) like concat(concat('%',#{creationDate}),'%')
and REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUNDED'
and ( REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUND_FAILED' or REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUNDING')
and (REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUNDED' or REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUND_FAILED' or REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUNDING')
and REFUND_STATUS = 'NOT_REFUNDED'
and REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUNDED'
and ( REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUND_FAILED' or REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUNDING' or REFUND_STATUS = 'NOT_REFUNDED')
group by m.MARGIN_ID order by p.LAST_UPDATE_DATE desc
